source.title: Absolute Path
source.description: The Flyo CDN supports on-the-fly image resizing and format conversion. Append the `?w=` and `?h=` query parameters to the asset URL; leave one of them out to have it derived from the original aspect ratio. Use `?format=` to return the resized image as `webp`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, or `gif`, for example: `image.jpg?w=250&h=250&format=webp`. see https://docs.flyo.cloud/doc/assets-images

id.title: ID
id.description: The unique identifier of the file or image as incremental number.

mime_type.title: MIME Type
mime_type.description: The MIME type of the file or image.

type.description: The type of the link. Possible values are: nitropagelink, url, email, tel, file

target.description: The target attribute of the link. Possible values are `_blank` (open in a new tab) or `_self` (same tab, the default).

raw.description: The not modified raw input value of flyo.

href.description: The link in a href format. Which means links have a trailing slash. E-Mail links start with mailto: and phone links start with tel:

extras.description: Additional information about the link. The set of keys varies depending on the type of link (e.g. file, url and nitropagelink each expose a different set of keys).

entity_slug.title: Entity Slug

entity_type_id.title: Entity Type ID

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Map of resolved route identifiers to URL paths, for example `routes.detail = "/foo-bar"`. Includes the system key `_empty` (boolean): `false` means at least one route could be resolved, `true` means no route is available for the current context.
